name: NCC Limited
summary: NCC Limited is a prominent construction and infrastructure company, active both within India and globally. Its extensive project portfolio includes the development of various structures such as industrial and commercial buildings, housing units, IT parks, medical facilities, sports arenas, and stadiums. The company also specializes in transportation infrastructure, constructing roads, highways, flyovers, and bridges. In the power sector, NCC handles the design, engineering, installation, testing, and commissioning of transmission lines, substations, and voltage distribution systems. Its railway operations cover earthworks, track laying, overhead electrification, and the development of freight corridors and railway sidings. Additionally, the company undertakes a wide range of water-related projects, including water supply and treatment systems, distribution networks, lift irrigation schemes, underground drainage, and sewage treatment plants, alongside major hydraulic structures like dams, reservoirs, canals, tunnels, hydroelectric power projects, barrages, spillways, and aqueducts. Beyond construction, NCC is involved in the power and metals industries and offers mine developer-cum-operator (MDO) services, which encompass overburden removal and the extraction of coal, lignite, and other minerals from open-cast mines. Established in Hyderabad, India, in 1978, the company was formerly known as Nagarjuna Construction Company Limited until its renaming to NCC Limited in March 2011.
